Playwright 1.60 driving system Chrome (headless, SwiftShader WebGL), two isolated browser contexts = two real users, against live server at `http://localhost:3001`. ### Steps 1. ✅ Signup via form → nav appears, home hero + 6 game cards render 2. ✅ Game page → title, stats, server-config table (6 rows) 3. ✅ Play → WebGL canvas live; held `W` 1.2s → frame pixel-diff confirms character moved 4. ✅ Second real user joined same lobby → leaderboard shows 2 players **on both clients**; join broadcast in chat 5. ✅ Chat alice→bob delivered cross-client, bubble over avatar (screenshot) 6. ✅ Studio: created place via UI, placed Kill Brick by clicking canvas → part persisted (2→3 parts); select tool opens properties panel 7. ✅ Collab: added bob via game page UI → both see each other's editor chips live; bob placed coin (persisted, 4 parts); team chat delivered 8. ✅ Avatar: recolor torso + save → toast, nav avatar updates 9. ✅ Catalog: bought Traffic Cone → balance ◈250→◈220 live in nav, card flips OWNED 10. ✅ Friends: request → accept → listed with presence dot 11. 🔍 Bad password → inline error. 1-char username → validation message. Unknown route → "Page not found", no crash 12. 🔍 Pasted `` into game chat → rendered as text, `window.__xss` undefined — no script execution 13. ✅ Zero console/page errors across both browsers, entire run Plus WS protocol suite: 37/37 (lobby instancing, movement relay, server-validated coin pickup, far-away goal touch rejected, studio op sync, permission denials). ### Findings — 3 real bugs found *only* by browser verification, all fixed - ⚠️ **Site completely broken on first browser load** — three.js r1xx splits into `three.module.js` + `three.core.js`; I'd only copied the first. 404 fell through to SPA fallback → HTML served as module → strict MIME check killed the whole JS graph. Backend tests could never catch this. Fixed (copied file), re-verified. - ⚠️ **Face rendered as black square on heads** — `drawFace()` cleared the canvas after the background fill; transparent canvas → black in opaque material. Fixed, avatar + catalog thumbs re-verified. - Clicking the nav link for the page you're already on doesn't re-render (no `hashchange`). Cosmetic; left as-is. - Earlier "leaderboard" WS test failure was a test artifact (stale queued broadcast), not a server bug — now 37/37. Server running at **http://localhost:3001** (3000 occupied by another app — auto-fallback worked as designed). Open two browsers, make two accounts, same game → you'll see each other.
